=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/stable_e2e_step_deep_verify.sh:104-169 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: In check_all_steps(), when gh_api_retry gives up on a rate limit (rc 75), the outer and recheck loops break with JOBS_JSON='{"jobs":[]}', so TOTAL_JOBS=0 reaches the "Run has no jobs after retries (spurious re-trigger) — OK" branch at lines 165-168, which returns 0 without setting DEEP_PASS=false, incrementing TOTAL_SKIPPED or appending to SKIPPED_STEPS.
  WHY: Under PAT rate limiting, the exact condition this PR targets, every phase whose jobs listing cannot be read passes with zero steps checked, the log wrongly says "spurious re-trigger", and deep_passed=true goes to GITHUB_OUTPUT (line 266, DEEP_PASS=true init at line 51), so the gate passes without verifying anything. All reviewers rate this MAJOR.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:5499-5550 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: In alt-model polling, DEADLINE is computed once at line 5499 and checked only at the top of the `while` loop at line 5511, so the gh_api_retry read at line 5512 can wait up to (3-1) x 600 = 1200 s past the deadline, and the terminal-label check at lines 5548-5550 then exits 0 without checking DEADLINE again.
  WHY: The polling phase can report success after its 4500 s deadline, which breaks the rule that waits stay within the step's remaining budget. Severities disagree: gemini, minimax and luna say MAJOR (confidence 5); z-ai_glm-5_3-flash says NIT (confidence 2) because the 90→110 min timeout raise covers 4500 s + 1200 s ≈ 95 min; the highest (MAJOR→high) is used.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:3089-3154 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The "Cleanup test artifacts" step computes cleanup_rl_wait once as min(600, time_left/8) and exports it as GH_RETRY_RATE_LIMIT_MAX_WAIT_SECS, then reuses that fixed cap across up to 11 gh_api_retry reads (10 run-list pages plus the late-PR listing), each of which can wait twice; the comment at lines 3095-3097 ("two reads that each wait twice still leave half of it for the writes") does not match the code.
  WHY: The worst case is about 22 x cap (e.g. ~1650 s with 600 s left), so the always() cleanup can run past the job's remaining time and its writes may not run. Severities disagree: luna says MAJOR; sonnet (confidence 3) and minimax (confidence 4) say NIT; the highest (MAJOR→high) is used.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "Route every read the gate makes through the existing rate-limit-aware helpers (gh_retry, gh_read, _safe_gh_jq in scripts/gh_helpers.sh) ... then the inline steps of .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml. Keep each call's request and output as they are; only the retry behaviour changes." (plus change 5: a contract test "That is what keeps new call sites from bypassing the helper again.")
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml `_safe_gh_jq` call sites at lines 2114, 2130 (dispatch-watch timeout-inventory), 3110 (Cleanup test artifacts PR-body read), 3213 (cleanup dispatch-review runs listing); tests/test_test_and_mark_stable_gh_rate_limit_routing.py
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: `_safe_gh_jq` (scripts/gh_helpers.sh lines 3242-3256) runs `gh api "$@"` once (line 3249) with no retry, no rate-limit classification and no wait for the reset, so the four reads at lines 2114, 2130, 3110 and 3213 still fail at once on a rate limit. At line 3110 a rate-limited read leaves `EXISTING_PR_BODY` empty, and the PATCH at line 3115 then replaces the PR body with only the cleanup note, which breaks the rule that each call's output stays as it is. The cap added at lines 3098-3103 has no effect on these reads. The `_GH_CALL` regex in tests/test_test_and_mark_stable_gh_rate_limit_routing.py matches only direct `gh (api|run|pr|issue)` calls, so the contract test cannot detect `_safe_gh_jq` sites. The previous editor's deferral ("these reads sit in polling loops that retry on the next cycle") does not apply to the single-shot timeout-inventory or cleanup reads. Routing through `gh_retry _safe_gh_jq` or `gh_api_retry` changes only the call sites. Severities disagree: sonnet says NIT (confidence 3) and glm says MAJOR (confidence 3); the others say MAJOR (confidence 5).
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/stable_e2e_step_deep_verify.sh:112-117, 153-156, 165-168 (check_all_steps()) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The new rc 75 branch (`if [ "${dv_read_rc}" -eq 75 ]; then ... break; fi`) breaks with JOBS_JSON '{"jobs":[]}'. The recheck loop breaks the same way after line 150 sets `JOBS_JSON='{"jobs":[]}'`. Line 165 then returns 0 with "spurious re-trigger — OK" and does not set DEEP_PASS=false or update TOTAL_SKIPPED/SKIPPED_STEPS.
  WHY: Under rate limiting, each of the four check_all_steps calls (lines 240-243) whose jobs listing cannot be read passes with zero steps checked, and line 266 writes deep_passed=true. The branch knows the result is "unreadable" and still sends it down the pass path.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:3095-3097 comment, 3098-3103 export, reads at 3138 (up to 10 pages) and 3154 ("Cleanup test artifacts") | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The cap is computed once and exported as one fixed value across up to 11 gh_api_retry reads, not two, so the comment's "half of it for the writes" arithmetic is neither accurate nor enforced.
  WHY: The worst case is 11 reads x 2 waits x (left/8), which goes past the job time left, and the comment misleads the next editor.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: "Route every read the gate makes through the existing rate-limit-aware helpers ... Keep each call's request and output as they are; only the retry behaviour changes."
  Expected change site: .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml, step "Cleanup test artifacts": line 3110 (`EXISTING_PR_BODY="$(_safe_gh_jq "repos/${TEST_REPO}/pulls/${PR_NUMBER}" --jq '.body // ""' || echo "")"`) and line 3213 (`_safe_gh_jq ".../runs?event=workflow_dispatch&branch=${BRANCH}&per_page=20"`)
  Evidence of absence: `_safe_gh_jq` (scripts/gh_helpers.sh lines 3242-3256) runs `gh api "$@"` once with no retry and no wait for the reset. A rate-limited read at line 3110 leaves EXISTING_PR_BODY empty, and the PATCH at line 3115 then overwrites the PR body. The `_GH_CALL` routing test cannot catch these sites. Calling `gh_api_retry` at the call sites needs no change to the helper.
  SEVERITY: NIT
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 3
- Pass-1 items checked and dropped (3 related items): the alt-model DEADLINE finding (lines 5511-5551) was dropped because a success after the wait is real and 110 min covers 95 min; a `cleanup_rl_wait=0` cap is fine (gh_helpers.sh lines 2869-2872); the fallback `|| gh_api_retry() { gh api "$@"; }` is fine.
- HARDENING_SUGGESTIONS (2 related items): in check_all_steps() lines 165-168, track `dv_last_rc` and record "listing unavailable" as skipped, or fail closed (8 lines); reword the comment at lines 3095-3097 (2 lines). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 3

- scripts/stable_e2e_step_deep_verify.sh:104-168 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: In check_all_steps(), on gh_api_retry rc=75 the outer and recheck loops break with JOBS_JSON as '{"jobs":[]}', and the script goes to the success path at line 165.
  WHY: The script wrongly reports success (deep_passed=true) and logs "spurious re-trigger" instead of retrying or failing when rate-limited.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:5499-5550 (alt-model polling) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `while [ "$(date +%s)" -lt "${DEADLINE}" ]; do` checks the deadline only before gh_api_retry, which can wait up to 1200 seconds if rate-limited.
  WHY: The loop can finish successfully well past the polling deadline, which breaks the rule that waits stay within the step's remaining budget.

  Evidence of absence: Reads using _safe_gh_jq in test-and-mark-stable.yml (e.g., lines 2114, 2130, 3110, 3213) call gh api directly without routing through the rate-limit-aware helpers.

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- scripts/stable_e2e_step_deep_verify.sh:104-120 (outer retry loop), 134-164 (recheck loop), 165-169 (zero-jobs branch) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: On deep_verify_gh_api_read rc=75 the loop breaks with JOBS_JSON='{"jobs":[]}' and TOTAL_JOBS=0. The zero-jobs branch prints "spurious re-trigger — OK" and returns 0 without setting DEEP_PASS=false, incrementing TOTAL_SKIPPED or appending to SKIPPED_STEPS. The recheck loop (140-163) does the same. The rc=75 `break`s at 114-117 and 153-156 came in the LAST RUN.
  WHY: Under PAT rate limiting, every phase whose listing cannot be read passes with zero steps checked, and DEEP_PASS=true at line 51 lets the e2e gate pass without verifying any run.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:5499, 5511-5513, 5548-5550 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: DEADLINE is computed once at line 5499 and checked only at line 5511. The gh_api_retry call at line 5512 can wait up to (3 - 1) x 600 = 1200 s, and the terminal-label check at lines 5548-5551 then exits 0 without checking DEADLINE again. The polling loop was not changed in the LAST RUN.
  WHY: A rate-limit reset that crosses DEADLINE extends the step by up to 1200 s past the 4500 s budget, and the step then exits with success.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:3089-3103 (Cleanup test artifacts), analogous scripts/stable_e2e_step_deep_verify.sh:27-42 deep_verify_rate_limit_max_wait | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `cleanup_rl_wait` = min(600, time_left/8) is computed once but applies to up to 11 reads (10 LATE_IMPL_PAGE at lines ~3135, plus LATE_PR_NUMBERS at line ~3151), so the worst case is ~22 x cap (~1650 s with 600 s left). The comment at line 3097 assumes 2 reads.
  WHY: A rate-limited burst can run the always() cleanup past its deadline, so the writes do not run. The fix is a per-call cap or a corrected comment and cap.
